name: Senate Majority PAC
summary: Senate Democrats' main super PAC, the counterpart to the Republican Senate Leadership Fund. It took in $305 million in the 2026 cycle by October, $244 million of it from 44 donors who gave $1 million or more; its nonprofit affiliate Majority Forward, which does not disclose donors, supplied about $61 million. It spent heavily to flip Michigan for Abdul El-Sayed.
